declared: 2026-10-31, WP-12 Phase 2b, written before any workcell_live_NNN Native episode of this stage. Physics (tlmpm_v5 law 8, final_v4), the goal evaluators, every v1-v4 and goal threshold, the blade_master_flat_board_v1 record and the WP-11 records are unchanged. Any change to these rules is a new stage file; failed runs are kept.
scope: LIVE Native results only (runtime_source live_isaac_sim): Isaac Sim 6.2 Kit/PhysX Franka articulation with the physically grasped ruler_knife_v2_y (two-finger physical_grasp, pregrasped at the workcell HOME) + retained TLMPM material (tlmpm_v5, law 8, 1 mm particles, 4 mm grid, 0.1 ms) + RTX cameras, on blade_master_flat_board_v1 (one solid board on the table, no risers). Material parameters are provisional and uncalibrated. One seed per episode, no repeat statistics, no Lab parity, never kinematic replay.

runtime.backend: scripts/run_wp10_live.py --runtime isaac_sim --scene/--goal (unchanged runner path of WP-11 Phase E live)
runtime.history_stride: max(5, ceil(live control steps / 40)), passed as --oracle-stride (WP-11 round-1 rule)
runtime.plan_preflight: runner default C2 plan preflight of the full plan must PASS before launch (staged per-protrusion geometry for >= 2 protrusions, runner default)

controller.planner: goal_planner_v1 (scene + goal + tool profile + options only; no particle, label, component or oracle input), WaypointPolicy
controller.planner_overrides_reason: The WP-11 Phase E live controller (1 deg / 1 mm per 20 ms step, path_v2, measured edge feedback), so the old/new comparison differs only in the workcell. sever_mid and divide_5_slices declare no planner block (v1 profile by default); path_v2 is applied as an override, which enters the task id.

duration_rule.text: As WP-11 Phase E live: probe-compile with the live options; plan end = first DONE knot of the ideal reference schedule; duration = ceil((1.1 x plan end + 1.0 s) / 0.5 s) x 0.5 s. The live goal JSON differs from the source goal JSON only in episode.duration_s.

episodes.success: goal evaluator verdict PASS and the WP-11 live task_success_requires list

PARTIAL_CUT_ACCEPTED when ALL hold at the end of the episode: (1) the sever evaluator's integrity layer PASS; (2) exactly one mechanical component (the evaluator's outcome metric mechanical_components == 1, i.e. no false separation; the sever verdict itself is expected FAIL); (3) a kerf exists: >= 1 particle carries a nonzero cut-0 digit; (4) no particle with a nonzero cut-0 digit has a reference (initial lattice) local z below 0.010 - 0.004 m (one grid cell of slack under the commanded stop depth, so labelling stops near the declared depth); (5) the plan finished, no grasp/IK failure. Anything else is PARTIAL_CUT_FAIL with the failed condition named.

episodes.reason: Declared after TRIM (workcell_live_003) passed the goal but, like WP-11 C5 (path_v2), its measured task path failed the report-only C2 blade clearance at PRE_CUT (blade 0.18 mm below the uncut bar top, cutting disabled). WP-11 C5b showed the cause is the path_v2 measured-feedback integrator and that path_v3 (live-validated in C5b) removes it. Controller variant only: same scene, goal, evaluator and thresholds; TRIM (path_v2) stays the primary record.

task_success_requires: goal evaluator verdict PASS (env.evaluate() = goals.evaluate_goal on the live recorded oracle history; for these non-sequence goals goal_eval_v1 and goal_eval_v2a dispatch to the same evaluator)
the scripted plan reached DONE within the episode
finite recorded material state and no solver error
no GRASP_FAILURE condition in the task phase (grasp lost, slip > 0.002 m or rotation > 0.05236 rad: the WP-11 live gates, grasp_monitor.GraspLossConfig warning gates)
no IK_FAILURE condition in the task phase (IK not ok or a workspace-clamped command)
home_outcome: Reported separately from the task outcome: HOME reset at the start (pregrasp PASS_STABLE_GRASP) and the Phase D physical return-to-home at the end (episode_lifecycle home_outcome).

measurements_report_only.knife_vs_board: Per control step: lowest blade-hull vertex (tool_profile blade shapes on the measured tool body pose) minus the board top (world z 0.010 m); min over the task phase, and the value at the end of each armed through-cut (HOLD), compared with the kinematic clean-cut window h in [0, +0.375] mm of Phase 2a.
measurements_report_only.material_into_board: Lowest recorded particle centre minus the board top and the count of particle centres below the board top over every recorded frame (privileged, evaluation only).
measurements_report_only.blade_reaction: TLMPM material reaction on the knife per step (current_material_reaction_impulse_world / dt).
measurements_report_only.board_reaction_inferred: Quasi-static, as Phase 2a: F_board = -(F_fingers - F_fingers,free) - F_material, with F_fingers from the native tensor contact view (finger/palm filters) and F_fingers,free the mean over the last 20 APPROACH/REORIENT steps of the first operation (no material contact). Inertia is neglected; the free-hover check against the tool weight is reported.
measurements_report_only.object_displacement: Mass-weighted centroid drift of the whole workpiece and of each final mechanical component between recorded frames, horizontal and vertical; per-cut drift for multi-cut episodes (frame before each CUT/SKIM starts vs frame after its WITHDRAW). WP-11 reference: ~1 mm per cut on separate supports.
measurements_report_only.bridges: Per through-cut plane: reference x-links crossing the plane with conflicting digits, and direct code-0 bridges (scripts/analyze_cut_bridges.py rule) at the end of the episode.
measurements_report_only.grasp: Task-phase and whole-episode max slip / rotation since settling (grasp monitor), grasp_lost.
measurements_report_only.ik_preflight: Plan preflight status, task steps with IK not ok, workspace / translation / rotation clamps, measured-path C2 check.
measurements_report_only.cameras: First and last recorded frames of the global D455 and both wrist D405: RGB, depth valid fraction and median, T_world_camera translation change (wrist cameras must move with the arm, the D455 must not).
measurements_report_only.performance: Process / episode wall time, mean step wall time (ms/step), material wall time per step.
